declarations.name: TOKENS_eq_tokens_aux
declarations.type:
∀ (P : Char → Bool) (ls : mlstring) (ss : List Char) (n len : ℕ),
  n + len = (explode ls).length →
    List.map explode (tokens_aux P ls ss n len) =
      match ss with
      | h :: t =>
        if len ≠ 0 ∧ ¬P (HOL4.EL n (explode ls)) = true then
          ((h :: t).reverse ++ (HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))).head!) ::
            (HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))).tail
        else if len ≠ 0 then (h :: t).reverse :: HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls)) else [(h :: t).reverse]
      | [] => HOL4.TOKENS P (HOL4.DROP n (explode ls))

declarations.name: exp_type_sound
declarations.type:
∀ (ctMap_ : ctMap),
  (∀ {ffi : Type} (s : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (es : List exp) (r : result (List v) v) (s' : cml_state ffi)
      (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (ts : List sem_t) (tvs : ℕ) (tenvS : tenv_store),
      evaluate s env es = (s', r) ∧
          tenv_ok tenv ∧
            tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
              good_ctMap ctMap_ ∧
                num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
                  type_all_env ctMap_ tenvS env { v := add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v, c := tenv.c, t := tenv.t } ∧
                    type_s ctMap_ s.refs tenvS ∧
                      (tvs ≠ 0 → HOL4.EVERY is_value es = true) ∧ type_es tenv (bind_tvar tvs tenvE) es ts →
        ∃ tenvS',
          type_s ctMap_ s'.refs tenvS' ∧
            store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
              s'.next_type_stamp = s.next_type_stamp ∧
                s'.next_exn_stamp = s.next_exn_stamp ∧
                  match r with
                  | result.Rval vs => HOL4.LIST_REL (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS') vs ts
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rraise val_) => type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS' val_ Texn
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rabort abort.Rtimeout_error) => True
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rabort (abort.Rffi_error a)) => True
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rabort abort.Rtype_error) => False) ∧
    ∀ {ffi : Type} (s : cml_state ffi) (env : sem_env) (val_ : v) (pes : List (pat × exp)) (err_v : v)
      (r : result (List v) v) (s' : cml_state ffi) (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (t1 t2 : sem_t) (tvs : ℕ)
      (tenvS : tenv_store),
      evaluate_match s env val_ pes err_v = (s', r) ∧
          tenv_ok tenv ∧
            tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
              good_ctMap ctMap_ ∧
                num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
                  type_all_env ctMap_ tenvS env { v := add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v, c := tenv.c, t := tenv.t } ∧
                    type_s ctMap_ s.refs tenvS ∧
                      type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ t1 ∧
                        type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS err_v Texn ∧ type_pes tvs tvs tenv tenvE pes t1 t2 →
        ∃ tenvS',
          type_s ctMap_ s'.refs tenvS' ∧
            store_type_extension tenvS tenvS' ∧
              s'.next_type_stamp = s.next_type_stamp ∧
                s'.next_exn_stamp = s.next_exn_stamp ∧
                  match r with
                  | result.Rval vs => type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS' vs.head! t2
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rraise val_) => type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS' val_ Texn
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rabort abort.Rtimeout_error) => True
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rabort (abort.Rffi_error a)) => True
                  | result.Rerr (error_result.Rabort abort.Rtype_error) => False

(∀ (cenv : env_ctor) (st : store v) (p : pat) (val_ : v) (bindings : List (varN × v)) (tenv : type_env) (ctMap_ : ctMap)

                HOL4.LIST_REL (fun p1 p2 => p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings tbindings →

              (new_tbindings ++ tbindings)) ∧
  ∀ (cenv : env_ctor) (st : store v) (ps : List pat) (vs : List v) (bindings : List (varN × v)) (tenv : type_env)
    (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tbindings new_tbindings : List (varN × sem_t)) (ts : List sem_t) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tvs : ℕ),
    ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧

            type_ps tvs tenv ps ts new_tbindings ∧
              type_s ctMap_ st tenvS ∧
                HOL4.LIST_REL (fun p1 p2 => p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings tbindings →
      pmatch_list cenv st ps vs bindings = match_result.No_match ∨
        ∃ bindings',

            HOL4.LIST_REL (fun p1 p2 => p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2) bindings'

declarations.type:
∀ (tvs : ℕ) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (val_ : v) (envS : List (store_v v)) (ts : List sem_t)
  (t1 t2 t : sem_t),
  (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tint ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ → ∃ n, val_ = v.Litv (lit.IntLit n)) ∧
    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tchar ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ → ∃ c, val_ = v.Litv (lit.Char c)) ∧
      (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tstring ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ → ∃ s, val_ = v.Litv (lit.StrLit s)) ∧
        (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tword8 ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ → ∃ n, val_ = v.Litv (lit.Word8 n)) ∧
          (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tword64 ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ → ∃ n, val_ = v.Litv (lit.Word64 n)) ∧
            (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tdouble ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ → ∃ n, val_ = v.Litv (lit.Float64 n)) ∧
              (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Ttup ts) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
                  ∃ vs, val_ = v.Conv none vs ∧ ts.length = vs.length) ∧
                (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tfn t1 t2) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
                    (∃ env n e, val_ = v.Closure env n e) ∨ ∃ env funs n, val_ = v.Recclosure env funs n) ∧
                  (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tref t1) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ type_s ctMap_ envS tenvS →
                      ∃ n v2,
                        val_ = v.Loc true n ∧
                          store_lookup n envS = some (store_v.Refv v2) ∧ type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS v2 t1) ∧
                    (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ Tword8array ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ type_s ctMap_ envS tenvS →
                        ∃ n ws,
                          val_ = v.Loc true n ∧
                            store_lookup n envS = some (store_v.W8array ws) ∧
                              HOL4.Finmap.FLOOKUP tenvS n = some store_t.W8array_t) ∧
                      (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tarray t) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ type_s ctMap_ envS tenvS →
                          ∃ n vs,
                            val_ = v.Loc true n ∧
                              store_lookup n envS = some (store_v.Varray vs) ∧
                                (∀ v_ ∈ vs, type_v 0 ctMap_ tenvS v_ t) ∧
                                  HOL4.Finmap.FLOOKUP tenvS n = some (store_t.Varray_t t)) ∧
                        (type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS val_ (Tvector t) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap_ →
                          ∃ vs, val_ = v.Vectorv vs ∧ ∀ v_ ∈ vs, type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS v_ t)

declarations.name: type_e_subst
declarations.type:
∀ (tenvE2 : tenv_val_exp),
  (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (e : exp) (t : sem_t),
      type_e tenv tenvE e t →
        ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : ℕ) (targs' : List sem_t),
          num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
              tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
                tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
                  tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
                    tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
                      HOL4.EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs = true ∧
                        tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
                          targs' = List.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) targs →
            type_e tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2)) e
              (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs' t)) ∧
    (∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (es : List exp) (ts : List sem_t),
        type_es tenv tenvE es ts →
          ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : ℕ) (targs' : List sem_t),
            num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
                tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
                  tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
                    tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
                      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
                        HOL4.EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs = true ∧
                          tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
                            targs' = List.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) targs →
              type_es tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2)) es
                (List.map (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs') ts)) ∧
      ∀ (tenv : type_env) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (funs : List (varN × varN × exp)) (env : List (varN × sem_t)),
        type_funs tenv tenvE funs env →
          ∀ (tenvE1 : tenv_val_exp) (targs : List sem_t) (tvs : ℕ) (targs' : List sem_t),
            num_tvs tenvE2 = 0 ∧
                tenv_abbrev_ok tenv.t ∧
                  tenv_ctor_ok tenv.c ∧
                    tenv_val_ok tenv.v ∧
                      tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
                        HOL4.EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs = true ∧
                          tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar targs.length tenvE2) ∧
                            targs' = List.map (deBruijn_inc 0 (num_tvs tenvE1)) targs →
              type_funs tenv (db_merge (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE1) (bind_tvar tvs tenvE2)) funs
                (List.map
                  (fun x =>
                    match x with
                    | (x, t) => (x, deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs' t))
                  env)

declarations.type:

declarations.type:

          type_ps (inc + tvs) tenv ps (List.map (deBruijn_subst inc targs') ts)

declarations.name: type_recfun_env
declarations.type:
∀ (funs : List (varN × varN × exp)) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tvs : ℕ) (tenv : type_env)
  (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (env : sem_env) (bindings : List (varN × sem_t)),
  tenv_ok tenv ∧
      type_all_env ctMap_ tenvS env { v := add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v, c := tenv.c, t := tenv.t } ∧
        tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
          num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
            type_funs tenv (bind_var_list 0 bindings (bind_tvar tvs tenvE)) funs bindings ∧
              HOL4.ALL_DISTINCT (List.map Prod.fst funs) = true →
    HOL4.LIST_REL (fun p1 p2 => p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v p2.2.1 ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2.2)
      (List.map (fun p => (p.1, v.Recclosure env funs p.1)) funs) (List.map (fun p => (p.1, tvs, p.2)) bindings)

declarations.name: type_recfun_env_help
declarations.type:
∀ (fn_ : varN) (funs funs' : List (varN × varN × exp)) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenv : type_env)
  (bindings : List (varN × sem_t)) (tenvE : tenv_val_exp) (env : sem_env) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tvs : ℕ)
  (bindings' : List (varN × sem_t)),
  HOL4.ALL_DISTINCT (List.map Prod.fst funs') = true ∧
      tenv_ok tenv ∧
        type_all_env ctMap_ tenvS env { v := add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v, c := tenv.c, t := tenv.t } ∧
          tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧
            num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧
              (∀ (fn_ : varN) (t : sem_t), HOL4.ALOOKUP bindings fn_ = some t → HOL4.ALOOKUP bindings' fn_ = some t) ∧
                type_funs tenv (bind_var_list 0 bindings' (bind_tvar tvs tenvE)) funs' bindings' ∧
                  type_funs tenv (bind_var_list 0 bindings' (bind_tvar tvs tenvE)) funs bindings →
    HOL4.LIST_REL (fun p1 p2 => p1.1 = p2.1 ∧ type_v p2.2.1 ctMap_ tenvS p1.2 p2.2.2)
      (List.map (fun p => (p.1, v.Recclosure env funs' p.1)) funs) (List.map (fun p => (p.1, tvs, p.2)) bindings)

declarations.type:

    type_e tenv (tenv_val_exp.Bind_name n 0 t1 tenvE) e t2 ∧ check_freevars (num_tvs tenvE) [] (Tfn t1 t2) = true

declarations.name: type_subst_deBruijn_inc_list
declarations.type:

  tvs.length = ts.length ∧ HOL4.EVERY (check_freevars 0 tvs) ts' = true →
    List.map (deBruijn_inc sk inc) (List.map (type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, ts)))) ts') =
      List.map (type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, List.map (fun t => deBruijn_inc sk inc t) ts))))
        ts'

declarations.name: type_subst_deBruijn_inc_single
declarations.type:
∀ (s : HOL4.Finmap tvarN sem_t) (t : sem_t) (ts : List sem_t) (tvs : List tvarN) (inc sk : ℕ),
  tvs.length = ts.length ∧ s = HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, ts)) ∧ check_freevars 0 tvs t = true →
    deBruijn_inc sk inc (type_subst s t) =
      type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, List.map (fun t => deBruijn_inc sk inc t) ts))) t

declarations.name: type_subst_deBruijn_subst_list
declarations.type:
∀ (t_ : sem_t) (tvs tvs' : List tvarN) (ts ts' ts'' : List sem_t) (inc : ℕ),
  tvs.length = ts.length ∧ HOL4.EVERY (check_freevars 0 tvs) ts'' = true →
    List.map (deBruijn_subst inc ts') (List.map (type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, ts)))) ts'') =
      List.map
        (type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, List.map (fun t => deBruijn_subst inc ts' t) ts)))) ts''

declarations.name: type_subst_deBruijn_subst_single
declarations.type:
∀ (s : HOL4.Finmap tvarN sem_t) (t : sem_t) (tvs tvs' : List tvarN) (ts ts' : List sem_t) (inc : ℕ),
  tvs.length = ts.length ∧ check_freevars 0 tvs t = true ∧ s = HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, ts)) →
    deBruijn_subst inc ts' (type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, ts))) t) =
      type_subst (HOL4.Finmap.alist_to_fmap (HOL4.ZIP (tvs, List.map (fun t => deBruijn_subst inc ts' t) ts))) t

declarations.name: type_subst_thm
declarations.type:
∀ (targs : List sem_t) (tvs' tvs : ℕ) (ctMap_ : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (v_ : v) (t : sem_t),
  type_v tvs ctMap_ tenvS v_ t →
    tvs = targs.length ∧
        ctMap_ok ctMap_ ∧ HOL4.EVERY (check_freevars tvs' []) targs = true ∧ check_freevars targs.length [] t = true →
      type_v tvs' ctMap_ tenvS v_ (deBruijn_subst 0 targs t)

declarations.name: type_tenv_val_weakening_lemma
declarations.type:
∀ (cm : ctMap) (tenvS : tenv_store) (tenvV : tenv_val) (envV : env_val) (cm' : ctMap) (tenvS' : tenv_store),
  weakCT cm' cm ∧
      weakS tenvS' tenvS ∧
        nsAll2
          (fun i val_ p =>
            ∀ (tvs' : ℕ) (cm'' : ctMap) (tenvS'' : tenv_store),
              (p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = tvs') ∧ weakCT cm'' cm ∧ weakS tenvS'' tenvS → type_v tvs' cm'' tenvS'' val_ p.2)
          envV tenvV →
    nsAll2 (fun x val_ p => type_v p.1 cm' tenvS' val_ p.2) envV tenvV
